result.reason: The redline meets the fallback position: affiliates are covered without even requiring notice, and the licence is transferable to a business successor in a merger, acquisition, or qualifying asset sale notwithstanding the anti-assignment provisions. It also adds the preferred contractor coverage. The edits are targeted and preserve the Authorized Location, fee, object-code, and non-exclusive-use limitations. It does not reach the full preferred position because it omits perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences and the uncured-material-breach termination standard for subscriptions. Drafting is generally professional, although the margin comment slightly overstates protection for all internal reorganizations.
